events.description: Rachel Green says Rachel Green is currently asking the crowd to excuse and pardon Rachel Green.
Flight Attendant says Flight Attendant is currently asking Rachel Green to show Rachel Green's boarding pass.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green does not have a boarding pass.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green is planning to talk to Ross Geller.
Flight Attendant says Flight Attendant is currently apologizing to Rachel Green.
Flight Attendant says Rachel Green is not allowed on the jetway unless Rachel Green has a boarding pass.
Rachel Green says Ross Geller has just gone onto the jetway.
Rachel Green says Ross Geller is right there on the jetway.
Rachel Green says Ross Geller is currently wearing a blue jacket.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green is asking Flight Attendant to give Ross Geller a message on Rachel Green's behalf.
Rachel Green says the message for Ross Geller is very important.
Flight Attendant says Flight Attendant is currently asking Rachel Green what the message is.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green does not know what message to send to Ross Geller.
Flight Attendant says Flight Attendant currently has a message for Man.
Flight Attendant says the message is from Rachel Green.
Flight Attendant says Rachel Green said that Rachel Green loved the present and will see Man when Man gets back.
Man says Man does not know what Rachel Green is talking about.
Man says there is no Rachel Green connected to Man.
Man says Flight Attendant is currently giving Man a cold, disapproving look.
